summary: Docs: a4 prefill runs every prefill row with NVFP4 activations; decode always stays W4A16
details: The README and option docs describe the row-type choice of vllm #977: PREFILL_ACTIVATIONS=a4 runs the prefill rows of every step with NVFP4 activations, and decode stays W4A16 (BF16 activations) in both modes with no extra variable.
